# Refund

Create refunds with `POST /refund` and query them with `GET /refund/{id}`. The request requires
`orderId`, `refundMerchantOrderId`, and `refundAmount`; reusing `refundMerchantOrderId` is
idempotent. Refund lifecycle webhooks include `refund.created`, `refund.succeeded`, and
`refund.failed`.
